data.name: ESCAPE: Orphanage
data.detailed_description:
You've always been the problem.

Kicked out of foster homes.

Returned by temporary families.

Discarded by every place that should have taken you in.

Now, as a last resort before being deemed "unrecoverable", you're brought to Scarlet Orphanage.

But as soon as you step through the rusty gates, something doesn't seem right.

The hallways are too quiet.

Voices echo when there shouldn't be anyone there.

At Scarlet Orphanage, you'll have to choose who to ally with, who to trust, and who to help... while exploring the darkest corners of a place that seems to watch your every move.

Your decisions shape the children's behavior, reveal hidden secrets, and determine which truth will come to light:

Is the orphanage haunted?

Is something manipulating everyone there?

Or was the real problem… always you?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Nanite and Lumen Software require a GPU compatible with SM6. DX11 is not supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 6 GB / AMD RX 6600 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Lumen in Software RT. For Hardware Ray Tracing (Cine/Epic quality), an RTX 3060 / RX 6700 XT is recommended.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains psychological horror themes, depictions of blood, and references to implied acts of violence.

Certain narrative events involve disturbing situations between children, including references to harm and death, though these events are not shown graphically on screen.

The horror experience focuses on atmosphere, tension, and psychological elements rather than explicit violence.

The game is intended for a mature audience.
